requests.name: continuous-body
requests.prompt: Use case: precise-object-edit. Production source artwork for the SAME dew-rabbit 2D game sprite. The provided complete rabbit is the exact design authority. Create ONE complete CONTINUOUS BODY layer by removing ONLY the head and the two ears. Keep the original cream torso, chest ruff with its mint dew drops, both front legs and paws, full rounded hindquarters and hind paw, and fluffy tail as ONE naturally painted connected anatomy. This must not look like a collage or separate cutouts. Preserve their original size, proportions, left-facing 3/4 camera, cream colors, soft painted fur, shading, all paw positions, tail position and silhouettes. Paint the complete hidden neck/shoulder surface beneath the removed head: a low rounded furry neck cap from about (195,286) to (300,310), connected naturally to the chest collar, not a flat cut and not a second head or a tall neck stump. Keep the large original transparent margins in a 512x512 world-space canvas; do NOT recenter, enlarge or tightly crop the body. Original rear silhouette near x420, grounded toes near y443. Chest and legs should be a single flowing, completely painted fur surface, with no straight clipping edges, missing wedges, disconnected joints, dark pasted outlines or holes. Each foreleg has a complete shoulder, smooth forearm and rounded toes, not detached feet. Fully joined tail at the rear, no circular cutoff. No head, no ears, no eye, no nose. Actual transparent background, no shadow, no ground, no text or marks. This is actual animation source artwork, not a preview.

requests.prompt: Use case: precise-object-edit. This is an intentionally HEADLESS continuous rabbit BODY source layer for animation, NOT a complete rabbit. Keep this exact body, leg anatomy, tail, mint chest dew drops, colors, fur detail, scale, canvas and all paw positions. The upper silhouette has been placed at the correct LOW shoulder/neck height. The entire image area above y280 in this 512x512 world-space canvas must stay transparent. No head, no skull, no tall neck stump, no ears, no eye or nose. Do not redraw or shift the rest of the body. Keep every leg continuously attached to the chest and hindquarters, same full rounded paws and full fluffy tail.
